# Crowded Kingdoms APIs

> Crowded Kingdoms is a platform for massive multiplayer worlds. There are two public APIs: one GraphQL API serving both the management surface (identity, organizations, apps marketplace, access tiers, billing, payments, quotas) and the game surface (runtime world/replication data and the realtime UDP-proxy subscription stream), and the Replication API / "Buddy" (a binary UDP wire protocol for low-latency spatial replication). The management and game surfaces are ONE endpoint — there is no separate management host to configure. Browser clients should use the CrowdyJS TypeScript SDK. Sign-in — email + password, a magic link, or a social provider — produces an identity session token; mint a separate app-scoped token for gameplay and realtime calls. Apps live in a single datacenter, so mintAppToken and gameClientBootstrap return the endpoint to use for that app — follow it rather than hardcoding a host. BigInt values are decimal strings; timestamps are ISO-8601 UTC.

## Start here (for AI agents and integrators)

- [For AI agents — quickstart & end-to-end workflows](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/overview/for-ai-agents): get a key on production, the SDL URLs, and the most common flows (register → token → host discovery → spatial send; and the studio-backend economy flow).
- [Best practices](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/overview/best-practices): authority in your server code on ck-exec (hubs and spokes), tokens and hosts.
- [Overview / client workflow](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/overview/client-workflow): one endpoint, two token types, and how an app's datacenter endpoint is discovered.
- [Before you ship](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/overview/before-you-ship): public hosts and aliases, and the SDK default origins a shipped client needs.
- [Players under 18 and player safety](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/overview/player-safety): Crowded Kingdoms opens to players aged 13 to 17 at one moment; what is live, what switches on at the opening, and what a game needs before it admits players under 18 (age screen, safety log, communication controls, reports and moderators, hub hooks).
- [Discord community support](https://discord.gg/x7tMKGwHf): ask questions and get help from the Crowded Kingdoms community.

## Schema (downloadable SDL)

- [Full SDL](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/schema/game-api.graphql) - the complete unified schema; start here.
- [Management-surface SDL](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/schema/management-api.graphql) - the same schema filtered to identity/orgs/apps/billing, for reading that surface alone.
- [CrowdyJS SDL](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/schema/crowdyjs.graphql)
- Production serves no GraphiQL and does not answer introspection; read the SDL above. The API is https://ck.prod.crowdedkingdoms.com/graphql. Crowded Kingdoms' dev and test environments are internal (staff and approved partners only) and refuse other accounts with TIER_ACCESS_REQUIRED.

## Management surface (identity, apps, billing) — same endpoint as the game surface

- [Management surface intro](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/management-api/intro)
- [Guide](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/management-api/readme)
- [GraphQL reference (operations & types)](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/management-api/reference/graphql-overview)
- [Management API best practices](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/management-api/best-practices) · [Shared environment](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/management-api/shared-environment) · [Game setup](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/management-api/game-setup)
- [Org-managed players: an organization signs its own players in (org tokens, signed assertions, the Org-Managed Players Addendum)](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/management-api/org-managed-players)
- [Age, country and who may play](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/management-api/age-and-territory): the checks at every sign-up, mint and refresh (TERRITORY_NOT_SUPPORTED, AGE_REQUIRED, AGE_REQUIREMENT_NOT_MET), birthDate/country/parentalConfirmation, recordPlayerAge, the neutral age screen, minPlayerAge, territoryPolicies, managed players' ageYears and country.
- [Legal documents](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/management-api/legal-documents): the platform's player documents, an app's own (setAppRequiredDocuments, appRequiredDocuments), recordPlayerConsents(appId), extensions.missingDocuments, the developer documents.

- [Teams](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/game-api/teams) · [Channels](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/game-api/channels) · [Avatar state](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/game-api/avatar-state) · [Actor state](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/game-api/actor-state)
- [Voice, video, contacts and blocks](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/game-api/communication): per-player send and receive settings per medium, contacts, blocks, parental consent for players under 18, and what the realtime servers refuse or drop · [Safety reports and moderation](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/game-api/safety-reports): fileSafetyReport, moderate_safety, safetyReports, resolve and escalate, what a report preserves
- [Game Kit (starter hubs on ck-exec and typed clients for them in every SDK)](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/game-kit/intro) · [The kit protocol (messages, action ids, refusal codes, shard keys, realtime events)](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/game-kit/protocol) · [The starter hubs](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/game-kit/starters) · [The clients](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/game-kit/clients) · [Deploying the starters](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/game-kit/deploy) · [Genres and the kit (which starters a kind of game begins from)](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/game-kit/genres) · [The economy and its limits (hub state, not a ledger)](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/game-kit/economy)
- [ck-exec (your server code: hubs, spokes and players' mods)](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/exec/intro) · [CLIENT halves (a mod's browser code)](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/exec/client-halves) · [From the legacy engines (game models, automations, compute modules, player code)](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/exec/from-the-legacy-engines) · [Players' data, blocks and reports (the erasure and export hooks, players.blocked, safety.report, age brackets)](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/exec/players-and-safety)
- [Agentic Crowdy Studio game integration (allowlisted development)](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/game-api/agentic-crowdy-studio): durable sessions/events, bounded host tools, approvals, leases, takeover, and reconnect. Verify the published SDK with `npm view @crowdedkingdoms/crowdyjs dist-tags`. Allowlisted development only; no production or real-money autonomy claim.
- [GraphQL reference (operations & types)](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/game-api/reference/graphql-overview)

## SDKs

- [CrowdyJS (browser-first TypeScript SDK) overview](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/crowdyjs/readme)
- [CrowdyJS best practices](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/crowdyjs/best-practices)
- [Build player mods with Crowdy Studio](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/build-a-game/bwf-mod-development): start from a game you run (The Construct locally, or a game that embeds Studio), the in-world Monaco/Rust workflow, server mods on ck-exec and client mods in the browser, author trust, and troubleshooting.
- [What a game needs for mods](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/crowdyjs/crowdy-studio-embed#what-a-game-needs-for-mods): the Studio dock, the `/dsh/` harness and its headers, cross-origin isolation for CLIENT mods, the access tier keys and `use_studio_agent`, and Allow Live Modding.
- [Mod authoring helper file](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/helpers/bwf-mod/authoring-checklist.txt) · [Cargo.toml](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/helpers/bwf-mod/Cargo.toml) · [client HUD Rust starter](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/helpers/bwf-mod/client-hud-lib.rs)
- CrowdyJS guides: [Channels](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/crowdyjs/channels) · [Teams](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/crowdyjs/teams) · [Grids](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/crowdyjs/grids) · [World Stores (SDK-managed actor/chunk/message state)](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/crowdyjs/stores)
- [Agentic Crowdy Studio player + CrowdyJS quickstart](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/crowdyjs/agentic-crowdy-studio)
- [CrowdyCPP (portable C++ SDK with native UDP replication) overview](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/crowdycpp/intro)
- [CrowdyCPP best practices](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/crowdycpp/best-practices)
- CrowdyCPP guides: [Installation](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/crowdycpp/installation) · [Quick start](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/crowdycpp/quick-start) · [Replication client (native UDP)](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/crowdycpp/replication-client) · [World session (SDK-managed game state)](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/crowdycpp/world-session) · [Engine integration (Unreal, Godot, Unity)](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/crowdycpp/engine-integration) · [Compatibility & parity](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/crowdycpp/compatibility)
- [CrowdyPy (Python SDK over the CrowdyCPP native core) overview](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/crowdypy/intro)
- [CrowdyPy best practices](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/crowdypy/best-practices)
- CrowdyPy guides: [Installation](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/crowdypy/installation) · [Quick start](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/crowdypy/quick-start) · [Replication (native UDP)](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/crowdypy/replication) · [World Stores](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/crowdypy/world-stores) · [Studio and player host](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/crowdypy/studio) · [Compatibility & parity](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/crowdypy/compatibility)
- [Build a game (tutorial)](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/build-a-game/intro)
- [Host your game](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/build-a-game/host-your-game): Crowded Kingdoms does not host games (Crowdy Games was retired on 2026-10-29). Serve your build from any static host that sends the headers: COOP/COEP for cross-origin isolation, the game's CSP, the separate `/dsh/` policy for the Studio agent, and sign-in through the app's redirect URIs and launch URL.

## Unreal SDK

- [Unreal SDK index for agents (llms.txt)](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/helpers/unreal-sdk/llms.txt): start here. Every Unreal SDK page with its URL and a one-line description, grouped into sections, each with a link to that section as one plain-text file (`llms-<section>.txt`, 20 to 430 KB; the largest sections are split by subfolder).
- [Unreal SDK docs root](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/unreal-sdk/intro): the Unreal Engine plugin, driven from C++ or Blueprint.
- [Unreal SDK quickstart](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/unreal-sdk/quickstart): sign in and sync your app, sign the player in at runtime, then build one lantern that shows an entity, an RPC event, and a replicated property.
- [For AI agents (Unreal SDK)](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/unreal-sdk/for-ai-agents): the fastest correct path for a coding agent working in an Unreal project on the plugin.
- [Unreal SDK agent drop-in file](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/helpers/unreal-sdk/AGENTS.md): copy into a project's root, `CLAUDE.md`, or `.cursorrules`.
- [Every Unreal SDK page in one file](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/helpers/unreal-sdk/llms-full.txt): all pages in reading order, with each page's source URL. About 1.6 MB, too large for most context windows; prefer the section files linked from the index. Blueprint graphs appear as pointers to their clipboard text under `/bp/unreal-sdk/`.
- [SDK symbol index (JSON Lines)](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/helpers/unreal-sdk/sdk-surface-index.jsonl): about 340 KB, one line per symbol with name, kind, module, header and, where known, the first sentence of its help text. Check it before the full inventory.
- [SDK surface inventory (JSON)](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/helpers/unreal-sdk/sdk-surface.json): every Blueprint-callable function, delegate, async action, subsystem, struct, enum, setting, console variable, metadata key, log category and C++ type the plugin exports, with module and header.
- Blueprint clipboard text: one plain-text file per Blueprint graph referenced from the docs, at `https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/bp/unreal-sdk/<graph>.txt` (for example [qs-entity](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/bp/unreal-sdk/qs-entity.txt)), named as the pointer lines in `llms-full.txt` name them, ready to paste into the editor.

## Minecraft

- [Minecraft server (in beta)](https://docs.crowdedkingdoms.com/minecraft/intro): a Fabric server hosts one shared world that vanilla Java clients join. Install the server jar, set the fixed seed, and split that world by chunk range.
